When a trap is applied during battle, lock battle escape/restart buttons in ESC menu.

options.name: The Red Mist Is Coming Weight
Book of Everything Mode
options.doc:
Chaos:
BoE drops are fully random

Balanced:
Burning more BoEs = higher chapter rewards, starting from canard pool
options.doc_fr:
Chaos:
Les gouttes BoE sont totalement aléatoires

Équilibré :
Burning more BoEs = récompenses chapitre supérieur, à partir de la piscine de canard

options.name: Book of Everything Pool
options.doc:
Select what pages will occur in boe drop pool

Downtier:
Only pages below goal repcetions are obtainable

Sametier:
Pages from goal receptions can be obtained

Uptier:
Pages from receptions above goal can be obtained (equal to sametier if goal = hana)

Uptier+:
Oliver, Ensemble and Black Silence pages are included in boe pool

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Incoming Death Link Effect
options.doc:
Select what happens when a Death Link is received from another player.

Lose Reception:
Immediately loses the entire reception, including all remaining floors.

Lose Floor:
Defeats only the current floor. The reception can continue on another floor when available.

Kill Random Librarian:
Kills one random librarian.

options.name: Send Death Link When
options.doc:
Select when this client sends Death Link to other players.

On Reception Loss:
Send only when the entire reception is lost.

On Floor Loss:
Send whenever the current floor is defeated.

On Librarian Death:
Send when a librarian dies.

options.name: Do not randomize goal receptions
options.doc:
Prevent Page Randomizer from changing enemy key pages and decks used by goal receptions.

This keeps goal fights from becoming much easier due to low HP/SR rolls or harmless passives.

options.name: Randomize dices between combat pages
options.doc: Randomize dice between regular combat pages.

options.name: Randomize EGO pages dices
options.doc: Randomize EGO pages dices.

options.name: Randomize Key pages stats
options.doc: Randomize key page stats such as HP, SR, speed and Dmg resists.

options.name: Randomize Key pages passives
options.doc:
Randomize regular key page passives, that can be transfered.

Untransferable passives is locked on its key pages and isn't randomized.

options.name: Randomize boss-exclusive passives
options.doc:
Disabled:
Boss-exclusives stay on their original bosses and are excluded from the randomizer pool.

Enabled:
Boss-exclusives are treated as regular randomizable passives,
except for hard-preserved boss passives that must never be removed.
options.doc_fr:
Handicapés:
Boss-Exclusives restent sur leurs patrons d'origine et sont exclus du bassin de randomisateur.

Activer & #160;:
Les boss-exclusifs sont traités comme des passifs randomisables réguliers, sauf pour les boss-passifs dures-préservés qui ne doivent jamais être enlevés.

options.name: Randomize Key pages speed dice amount
options.doc: Randomize key page speed dice amount with weighted odds favoring lower values.

options.name: Randomize Key pages passive amount
options.doc:
Randomize how many extra regular passives are added to each key page.

Requires "Randomize Key pages passives" to have any effect.

options.name: Randomize combat pages passives
options.doc: Experimental combat page script/passive-effect randomization within safe page buckets.
options.doc_fr: Randomisation expérimentale de la page de combat/effet passif dans des seaux de page sûrs.

options.name: Ignore combat dice bundles
options.doc:
Randomize combat page dice from one shared dice pool instead of preserving page/range bundles.

This is experimental and can put mass-attack dice on normal pages or normal dice on mass attacks.

options.name: Randomize combat dice amount
options.doc:
Roll a new dice count for each randomized combat page.

Counts 1-3 are common, while 4-7 become increasingly rare.

options.name: Randomize Key Pages untransferable passives
options.doc: Randomize untransferable key page passives while preserving hard-locked boss passives.
